14:17.race_name: Prestige Security Executive Protection Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Chase

runners.comment: All five wins have been gained here but arrives under a cloud; yard back among the winners
runners.name: Alto Alto
runners.spotlight: All his five victories have been gained here but he arrives under a cloud, last of five in 2m1f handicap chase here last month; yard is back among the winners though so not totally dismissed.

runners.comment: Scored at Leicester; solid fifth at Newton Abbot 15 days ago; ought to be in the shake-up
runners.name: Begin The Luck
runners.spotlight: Reliable sort who scored at Leicester (2m4f) in March; not discredited when fifth in 2m5f handicap chase at Newton Abbot 15 days ago so ought to be in the shake-up eased 1lb.

runners.comment: Back on track when third at Hereford 25 days ago; needs considering with cheekpieces added
runners.name: Line Of Descent
runners.spotlight: Scored three times over fences (at up to 2m4f) in the first half of 2023; quite lightly raced since but comes here on the back of a good third of nine in 2m5f handicap chase at Hereford 25 days ago; needs considering with cheekpieces added.

runners.comment: Very good second here two weeks ago; drops in trip but on the up so still rates a player
runners.name: Delgany Deadline
runners.spotlight: Low-mileage 6yo who got off the mark at Leicester (2m7f) in February before posting a very good second of four in 3m1f handicap here two weeks ago; drops in trip but on the up so still rates a player for yard firmly among the winners.

runners.comment: Arrives below par, third of four here two weeks ago; tried in different headgear now
runners.name: Angels Dream
runners.spotlight: Gained a maiden success over fences at Lingfield (2m) in November 2024 but lightly raced since and below par, coming in only third of four over 2m1f here two weeks ago; tried in different headgear now.

14:52.race_name: Mansell McTaggart Mane Event Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Quirky for previous yard but could get his act together on debut for Dan Skelton
runners.name: Ballyeaston
runners.spotlight: Consistent for previous yard but seems quirky and hung left en route to second-place finishes over 2m3f/2m5f the last twice; that said, could get his act together on debut for Dan Skelton and it's interesting that Harry Skelton prefers him over the higher-rated Loriko.

runners.comment: Has achieved little in two hurdles contests since returning from long absence
runners.name: Giddyupadingdong
runners.spotlight: Very lightly raced; bumper winner in 2023 for previous yard but has achieved little in two hurdles contests since returning from long absence; handicaps should be more suitable shortly.

runners.breeder: E U R L Agb Agency & Olivier Rambert
runners.comment: Beaten favourite over C&D last time but first-time headgear may have positive effect
runners.name: Loriko
runners.owner: Cherry Knoll Farm M Ward & D Skelton
runners.spotlight: Beaten favourite in similar event over C&D last time and is today deserted by Harry Skelton who prefers new stablemate Ballyeaston; otherwise again sets the standard on best form, which includes a good effort (behind useful sort) at Ascot; first-time headgear may have positive effect.

runners.comment: Booking of Harry Cobden suggests a bigger effort may be on the way; reappearance
runners.name: Moon Monarch
runners.spotlight: Showed some promise in bumpers but hasn't fared so well in two attempts over hurdles, latest 14 months ago; however, booking of Harry Cobden suggests a bigger effort may be on the way.

runners.comment: Comfortably held in Irish points and a C&D maiden
runners.name: Oblemenko
runners.spotlight: Comfortably held in two Irish points and a C&D maiden (behind Loriko); best watched unless the market suggests he's likely to take a step forward.

runners.comment: Record of only 1-24 on Flat; brings limited potential to hurdles
runners.name: Versatile
runners.spotlight: Record of only 1-24 on Flat and only sixth in a couple of low-grade AW handicaps for new stable; brings limited potential to hurdles.

runners.comment: Has form figures of 122 on good ground and is one of the main players
runners.name: Shutfrontdoor
runners.owner: J Hinds A Head & G L Moore
runners.spotlight: Raced only four times and has produced form figures of 122 in good-ground attempts, the success in bumper; faller on hurdles debut, then earned her latest silver medal at Kempton (2m) where she was no match for the winner but ran respectably; one of the main players.

runners.comment: Needs improvement on his Fontwell form
runners.name: Khalkeau Spigao
runners.owner: D S Dennis & John Hw Finch
runners.spotlight: Fontwell form comprises a modest fourth (ran below market expectations) and heavy defeat; needs improvement.

15:27.race_name: BetGoodwin Sussex Stayers' Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Useful sort who can't be written off, albeit has stamina to prove back up in distance
runners.name: East India Express
runners.spotlight: Disappointing favourite back at the Cheltenham Festival (2m4f); otherwise a useful sort and had returned to form with close second at Windsor the time before; not written off, albeit has stamina to prove back up in distance.

runners.comment: Beaten when taking a late fall last time; can be opposed in this deeper field
runners.name: Kamsinas
runners.spotlight: Has faced a couple of difficult tasks since returned to hurdles but was beaten when taking a late fall returned to handicap level most recently; can be opposed off current mark in this deeper field.

runners.comment: Likely player provided he bounces back with usual hood removed; capable of useful form
runners.name: Double Powerful
runners.spotlight: Good second in major handicap at Kempton (2m5f) in January, putting a few non-completions (fences/hurdles) behind him; has performed below market expectations in two starts since but is a likely player provided he bounces back with usual hood removed.

runners.comment: Absent since October double; returns to action off a stiffer mark in deeper waters
runners.name: Roger Pol
runners.spotlight: Absent since an October double (2m7f Class 3) that took his hurdles record to 4-12; returns to action off a stiffer mark in deeper waters and looks by no means certain to bag the hat-trick.

runners.comment: Never going well en route to a modest third last time; needs to travel better
runners.name: Bethpage
runners.spotlight: Fairly useful mare who has Listed form but was never going well en route to a modest third at Ascot (2m5f) when back from a layoff last time; will need to travel better in this competitive affair.

runners.comment: Proving a solid novice hurdler; looks worth his mark; possibilities on handicap debut
runners.name: Fountains Blenhein
runners.spotlight: Proving a solid novice hurdler; scored in October/January and ran well under big penalty the last twice, beaten only a neck at Kempton (2m5f, good) latest occasion; bred to be as effective back up in trip; looks worth his mark and has clear possibilities on handicap debut.

runners.comment: Has form figures of 11222 since handicapping; Sean Bowen booked; warrants respect
runners.name: Turndlightsdownlow
runners.spotlight: Has form figures of 11222 (at up to 3m) since handicapping; posted another sound effort last time when bidding to take his Kempton record (2m5f, good) to 3-3; there is a chance he can still show further progress and win more races; Sean Bowen booked; respected.

runners.comment: Creditable second at Plumpton last April in most recent hurdles attempt
runners.name: Elysian Knight
runners.spotlight: Record of 0-4 switched to fences this term, albeit far from disgraced on two occasions; 2-6 over hurdles and finished a creditable second at Plumpton (2m4f) last April in most recent attempt; each-way possibilities.

runners.comment: Won at Wincanton last time; fairly consistent and may remain competitive
runners.name: Moveit Like Minnie
runners.owner: F J Mills & W R Mills
runners.spotlight: Justified favouritism at Wincanton (2m4f, good) last time, recording a first win over hurdles since 2023; fairly consistent and looks worth a crack at this new trip so may remain competitive; whether he can follow up is a different matter.

runners.comment: Broadly progressive form since November; scored readily at Newton Abbot last time
runners.name: Top Guy
runners.spotlight: Broadly progressive form since November features two wins, including at Newton Abbot (3m2f, good) latest start when doing it readily; may continue to improve; one to consider, despite going up a further 10lb and Harry Skelton preferring stablemate Tranquil Sea.

runners.comment: Has become attractively treated and Harry Skelton prefers him over the improving Top Guy
runners.name: Tranquil Sea
runners.spotlight: Had further wind surgery prior to a poor effort last time (2m5f) but may benefit from this step back up in trip and he has become attractively treated, being 3lb below the mark he defied in October (2m7f); Harry Skelton prefers him over the improving Top Guy; interesting.

runners.comment: Has five wins over fences but has been pulled up on his last three starts.
runners.name: Northern Poet
runners.spotlight: Has five wins over fences, including over C&D, but has been pulled up on his last three starts; back on last winning mark and first-time visor now goes on but he comes with risks.

runners.comment: Has taken well to fences this term and opened his account over C&D in January.
runners.name: Lumi Plugin
runners.owner: J Hinds A Head & G L Moore
runners.spotlight: Has taken well to fences this term and opened his account when scoring over C&D (soft) in January; ran up to that form when runner-up back over C&D and at Kempton since and must hold sound claims.

runners.comment: Veteran chaser who landed his third win of the season, over C&D (soft) in February.
runners.name: Enjoy dAllen
runners.spotlight: Veteran chaser who landed his third win of the season, over C&D (soft) in February when getting the better of Lumi Plugin; found the Sussex National back here 13 days ago a tad too competitive but cannot be dismissed here back in the right grade.

runners.comment: Both wins over fences have been over C&D; drops in grade; taken very seriously
runners.name: Sea Invasion
runners.spotlight: Both wins over fences have been over C&D, the first in first-time headgear a year ago; not at his best when fifth in the Sussex National back here 13 days ago but must be taken seriously down in grade with visor replacing blinkers.

runners.comment: Has three wins over fences, including one over C&D; not operating at his best this year.
runners.name: Morfee
runners.spotlight: Has three wins over fences, including one over C&D; not operating at his best this year and a pull in the weights from when third over C&D in February (soft) should not see him reverse placings with either Lumi Plugin or Enjoy d'Allen.

runners.comment: Landed a three-timer in November/December but was pulled up at Fontwell in January.
runners.name: Roe And Co
runners.spotlight: Landed a three-timer in November/December but was pulled up on soft when favourite at Fontwell (3m2f) in January when he was reported to have bled from the nose; returns from a break and needs to hit the ground running to get back on track.

16:37.race_name: Diane And Harry's Plumpton Annual Box Handicap Hurdle

runners.breeder: Lasnawood Ltd & Tullis Park Rose Ltd
runners.comment: Progressing well and cosily off the mark here latest; more to offer and leading claims
runners.name: Shalfa
runners.spotlight: Fair 1m2f Flat scorer; progressing really well in this sphere and she cosily got off the mark over 2m2f here two weeks ago; up 3lb but this strong-travelling sort is capable of better still; leading claims.

runners.comment: Good second here two weeks ago; must enter calculations up 1lb in a change of headgear
runners.name: Market House
runners.spotlight: On a losing run but he has been running well on the Flat and returned to hurdling with a good second of eight in 2m4f handicap here two weeks ago; must enter calculations nudged up 1lb in a change of headgear.

runners.comment: Easily best effort over hurdles when C&D third latest; well in the mix now handicapping
runners.name: Answer That
runners.spotlight: A fair ex-Irish bumper performer who recorded easily his best effort over hurdles when third of five in novice over C&D 13 days ago; well in the mix with likely better still to come now handicapping.

runners.comment: Arrives well below par, tenth back on Flat at Doncaster latest; change of headgear tried
runners.name: Dissident
runners.spotlight: Opened his account in Doncaster juvenile hurdle (2m) in December; well below par subsequently though, back on the Flat when tenth at Doncaster 22 days ago; change of headgear now tried.

runners.comment: Ended time with Gary and Josh Moore out of sorts; pulled up over C&D on recent yard debut
runners.name: Fascinating Lips
runners.spotlight: A fair 2m2f hurdles winner at his best but he ended his time with Gary and Josh Moore out of sorts before Christmas; pulled up on his yard debut over C&D recently and tongue-tie is added here.

runners.comment: Too free when fading Stratford fourth latest; remains with potential on h'cap debut though
runners.name: Alibey
runners.spotlight: Capable of fair form (for William Haggas) on the Flat; yet to match that in this sphere for her current handler, again going too freely when a fading fourth of 11 in 2m Stratford novice 22 days ago; remains with potential on her handicap debut though if becoming more tractable.

runners.comment: Ready Stratford scorer 22 days ago; hiked up 9lb but still merits serious consideration
runners.name: Lord Of The Glance
runners.spotlight: On the up since sent into handicaps and he readily landed 11-runner event at Stratford (2m) 22 days ago, forging clear from final flight; hiked up 9lb but still merits serious consideration.

runners.comment: Fair Flat winner for Andrew Balding; yet to show any form of note in a trio of hurdles
runners.name: Chartwell Jock
runners.spotlight: A fair 1m2f Flat winner for Andrew Balding; yet to show any form of note in three juvenile hurdles this winter though and needs this switch to handicap company to yield major progress.

runners.comment: Offered little promise over hurdles, tenth at Newbury in November; handicap debutante
runners.name: Mystical Mabel
runners.spotlight: Well held on the Flat and she has also offered little promise since sent hurdling, only tenth in Newbury juvenile in November; makes her handicap debut after a layoff.

runners.comment: Yet to fire for his current yard under both codes; not easy to make a case for
runners.name: Banksman
runners.spotlight: A fair 1m Flat winner for Jack Channon last summer but yet to fire for his current yard under both codes, tried in cheekpieces when eighth in 1m4f AW Lingfield handicap in January; not easy to make a case for.

17:12.race_name: Kalm Club Keep Calm & Gallop On Handicap Hurdle

runners.comment: Not seen over hurdles for nearly two years but is on an attractive mark; 4-8 at Plumpton
runners.name: Alien Storm
runners.spotlight: Came up short last time when bidding for a chase hat-trick; only 1-11 over hurdles and hasn't raced in this sphere for nearly two years but there are positives, namely a lower mark in this sphere and a good overall record (4-8) at Plumpton.

runners.comment: Needs to rebound but his record of 211 at Plumpton augurs well; headgear removed
runners.name: Goodwin
runners.spotlight: Needs to rebound, having been out of form since the turn of the year; however, has a record of 211 at Plumpton, most recently winning off just 1lb lower in November; return to this venue may have positive effect; goes without headgear for first time in a while.

runners.comment: Won this contest off 5lb higher 12 months ago; fighting chance if back in similar form
runners.name: Hecouldbetheone
runners.spotlight: Spell over fences featured two wins last June; unable to take advantage of drop to selling level back over hurdles last time but won this contest off 5lb higher 12 months ago (admittedly beat only two rivals) and has a fighting chance provided he's back in similar form.

runners.comment: Showed major signs of a revival in first-time cheekpieces most recently; respected
runners.name: Notnowlinda
runners.spotlight: Skelton mare who showed major signs of a revival in first-time cheekpieces at Uttoxeter (2m4f) most recently, finishing a close third; remains 3lb below the mark she defied at Hereford (2m) two years ago; warrants respect in the retained headgear.

runners.comment: Well treated on her wins in 2023 and 2024, so can't be totally dismissed
runners.name: Hiconic
runners.spotlight: Not entirely solid on hurdles form this term and her second-place finish in latest Flat start came off a basement mark; however, looks well treated on her wins in summer 2023 and 2024, so can't be totally dismissed.

runners.comment: Juvenile hurdler who has consistent form; looks ready for a crack at this new trip
runners.name: The Bellhop
runners.spotlight: Juvenile hurdler whose consistent form features two wins over 2m1f at Fontwell; ran creditably in 4yo handicaps at Sandown and Ascot the last twice; gives the impression he's ready for a crack at this new trip; likely player, taking on elders who are largely exposed.

runners.comment: Latest effort took his record at 2m3f-2m5f to 122; may do better still; solid claims
runners.name: Oakleys Way
runners.spotlight: Solid record in 2m3f-2m5f attempts comprises an account-opening success at Taunton (good to firm) in November and second-place finishes, including at Plumpton, in last two starts; may do better still at this sort of distance; solid claims.

17:47.race_name: BetGoodwin Mares' Open National Hunt Flat Race (Category 2 Elimination) (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Bred for jumps and yard has a poor strike-rate in bumpers
runners.name: Cheese
runners.spotlight: Dam 2m-2m4f hurdle/chase winner, half-sister to French 2m2f-2m4f hurdle/chase scorer Great Parade; yard has a poor strike-rate in bumpers; looks one for jump races in due course.

runners.breeder: R D And Mrs J S Chugg
runners.comment: From a useful family and may leave her Ffos Las effort behind
runners.name: Mirabello
runners.spotlight: Finished tailed-off last of five at Ffos Las but the soft ground possibly didn't suit and/or something was amiss; in good hands and from a useful family; may leave that effort behind.

runners.breeder: J Barber R Hall & C Slocombe
runners.comment: Point winner; runner-up at Wincanton on the switch to rules; major player
runners.name: Posh Chick
runners.spotlight: Successful in the first of two attempts in points; filled the runner-up spot at Wincanton (good) on the switch to rules; one of the main form contenders in this field, along with stablemate Steal A Glance.

runners.comment: Needs improvement on her Huntingdon form
runners.name: Skye Glance
runners.spotlight: Huntingdon form comprises a non-completion (brought down) and eighth of nine; needs improvement on the latter effort.

runners.comment: Fitting of hood needs to make a big difference
runners.name: Golden Sanjida
runners.spotlight: Modest fourth at Fakenham then failed to beat a rival at Huntingdon; fitting of hood needs to make a big difference.

runners.comment: Stable's respectable record in bumpers this term includes winning newcomers
runners.name: Silver Whisper
runners.spotlight: £5,000 3yo; unraced dam closely related to useful winners Whisperinthebreeze (2m hurdle/2m5f chase) and Silver Kayf (2m3f/2m5f hurdle), out of bumper scorer; stable's respectable record in bumpers this term includes winning newcomers; Sean Bowen booked; interesting.

runners.comment: Close second at Ludlow then midfield at Wincanton; this looks weaker
runners.name: Steal A Glance
runners.spotlight: Out of a bumper/hurdle winner for her yard; faded into midfield at Wincanton, failing to back up her close second at Ludlow, but this looks weaker and she may yet progress; shortlist material.

13:58.race_name: George Wood Years Of Service Mares' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Remote when fourth on last month's hurdling debut; improvement required
runners.name: After The Ball
runners.spotlight: Showed some promise in Irish points (albeit without winning) but was remote when fourth on last month's hurdling debut at Bangor (2m, good) and needs to take a good step forward here.

runners.comment: Last of 13 when making debut in Warwick bumper in November
runners.name: Bonnets Secret
runners.spotlight: Last of 13 when making debut in Warwick bumper (good to soft) in November; can only be watched on this hurdling debut.

runners.comment: Showed fair form when placed on both hurdling starts; leading contender
runners.name: Hornica
runners.spotlight: Made the frame in big-field Cheltenham bumper (good ground) last April and showed fair form when placed in two soft-ground novice hurdles at start of this year; ideally needs to learn to settle better but has strong claims.

runners.comment: In the frame in all three bumpers and all three hurdling starts; each-way claims at least
runners.name: Lady Kara
runners.spotlight: Runner-up on hurdle debut at Hereford (2m, good) in October and both subsequent fourths (2m5f/2m) were respectable; reportedly had a breathing issue last time and now returns from break with a tongue-tie fitted; each-way claims at least.

runners.comment: Well beaten when a big-priced outsider for debut at Hereford in November
runners.name: Liasse dArgent
runners.spotlight: Well beaten when a big-priced outsider for debut at Hereford (2m, good) in November.

runners.comment: Out of half-sister to useful jumper Yalltari; has fair standard to reach on debut
runners.name: Lilycala
runners.spotlight: Fourth foal; dam unplaced in bumper/2m hurdles, half-sister to useful jumper Yalltari; wears tongue-tie on debut; has fair standard to reach.

runners.comment: Only fourth of six on handicap debut but the faster ground here ought to suit better
runners.name: Merely A Detail
runners.spotlight: Good-ground bumper winner who has made the frame on all four hurdling starts; managed only fourth of six on handicap debut at Fakenham (2m, soft) in December but the forecast faster ground here ought to suit better; shortlisted.

runners.comment: Well-bred mare; first glimmer of promise when fourth at Chepstow last month
runners.name: Miss Denver
runners.spotlight: Struggled on first two outings (bumper/hurdle) but this well-bred mare showed her first glimmer of promise when fourth, albeit well held, at Chepstow (2m, good to soft) last month, and ought to have more to offer.

runners.comment: Lowly rated Flat maiden; pulled up (saddle slipped) when 250-1 for hurdle debut
runners.name: Pink Walls
runners.spotlight: Lowly rated Flat maiden; 250-1 for recent hurdling debut at Haydock, where a mid-race jumping error caused saddle to slip and he was pulled up.

runners.comment: Third foal from a fair 2m hurdle/chase winner; wears a hood on debut
runners.name: Willow Edge
runners.spotlight: Third foal from a fair 2m hurdle/chase winner; wears a hood on debut, which is somewhat unnerving.

runners.comment: Dropped out tamely last time but form of earlier Kelso second gives her a shout
runners.name: Yeld To Call
runners.spotlight: Tamely dropped out of contention in valuable series final at Kelso (2m, good to soft) last month but posted good effort when second at Taunton (2m, heavy) two starts ago and has possibilities if able to replicate that form on the quicker surface here.

runners.breeder: S C E A De La Vallee De LOrne
runners.comment: Well held when 80-1 for recent hurdle debut at Fontwell
runners.name: Mega Etoile
runners.spotlight: Made fairly encouraging bumper debut on heavy ground in February but well held twice since, latterly when 80-1 for recent hurdle debut at Fontwell.

runners.comment: Struggled on first two appearances, the latter over C&D three weeks ago
runners.name: Minnie Belle
runners.spotlight: Struggled on first two appearances, the latter over C&D three weeks ago.

14:33.race_name: Green 4 Motor Company 30th Anniversary Handicap Hurdle

runners.comment: Course winner; very good Fontwell second latest; tries longer trip but weighted to go well
runners.name: Juggernaut
runners.spotlight: Course winner; resumed from four months off back hurdling with a very good second of seven in 2m2f Fontwell handicap 23 days ago; tries a much longer trip now after that strong-finishing effort and weighted to go well off a 1lb lower mark.

runners.comment: Back to 2m when solid fourth at Hereford latest; not out of things over this longer trip
runners.name: Getaway With You
runners.spotlight: Bagged a fourth success of the season at Chepstow (2m3f) in February; seemed unsuited by dropping back to 2m when a solid fourth of ten at Hereford 13 days ago and not out of things over this more suitable distance.

runners.comment: Failed to build on earlier promise when Sedgefield sixth last month; could bounce back
runners.name: Scudamore
runners.spotlight: Winless since scoring over 2m2f here in April 2023; failed to build on earlier promise when sixth of seven in 3m3f Sedgefield handicap last month but could bounce back in different headgear now.

runners.comment: Solid third at Market Rasen last month; ought to be thereabouts again eased 1lb
runners.name: Seahouses
runners.spotlight: Scored at Market Rasen (2m7f) in November and posted another solid effort when third of six in another 2m7f handicap there last month; ought to be thereabouts eased 1lb.

runners.comment: Good second at Catterick last time; he's in the mix once more
runners.name: East Eagle
runners.owner: Mrs Janet Cooper & M E Sowersby
runners.spotlight: Back to winning ways at Catterick (3m1f) in January and has continued in good form, second of eight in another 3m1f handicap there last time; in the mix once more.

runners.comment: Hinted at promise this season until beating one here in October; returns after a wind op
runners.name: Floating Rock
runners.spotlight: Course winner in 2022; had hinted at promise this season until beating only one in 2m2f handicap here in October; returns after wind surgery now.

runners.comment: Breakthrough success at Warwick 24 days ago; not taken lightly despite 2lb weights rise
runners.name: Kampari
runners.spotlight: Seemed well suited by the longer trip when gaining a breakthrough success in 3m2f Warwick handicap hurdle 24 days ago; not taken lightly despite a 2lb weights rise.

runners.breeder: John Goodman & The Late Owen Brennan
runners.comment: Opened her account at Leicester (2m4f) in November but well below par subsequently
runners.name: Jewel Eyed Judy
runners.spotlight: Opened her account at Leicester (2m4f) in November but well below par subsequently, tried in cheekpieces when pulled up at Taunton (3m) 26 days ago; tongue-tie is added now.

runners.comment: Remains without a win; below-par fifth of nine in 3m1f handicap at Huntingdon latest
runners.name: The Last Drop
runners.spotlight: Remains without a win and she came in a below-par fifth of nine in 3m1f handicap at Huntingdon last month; others appeal more.

runners.comment: Little to enthuse over in three maiden hurdles this season; undergone breathing surgery
runners.name: The Kings Soldier
runners.spotlight: Little to enthuse over in three maiden hurdles this season, beating only one at Market Rasen (2m4f) last month; has undergone breathing surgery ahead of his handicap debut.

15:08.race_name: Mid Warwickshire Cleaning Supplies Mares' Handicap Hurdle

runners.comment: Non-runner
runners.name: Miss Maverick
runners.spotlight: Non-runner.

runners.comment: Enjoyed resurgence last year (four wins) but returns from break on fairly tough mark
runners.name: Max Of Stars
runners.owner: Mrs S D Pearson & Ollie Pears
runners.spotlight: Front-runner who enjoyed a resurgence last year, winning three times over hurdles and once on the Flat; absent since November, though, and will need to resume in peak form to have any chance off current mark.

runners.comment: Placed in Grade 2/Listed races in the autumn but tailed off in a handicap last month
runners.name: Jaminska
runners.spotlight: Close third in Cheltenham Grade 2 novice (2m good to soft) in October and again ran commendably well when third in Newbury Listed race (2m, soft) a few weeks later but was tailed off when reappearing in a handicap last month and it's hard to know what to expect from her here.

runners.breeder: Mrs A L Merry & Mr Brett Merry
runners.comment: Shade disappointing last time but this largely consistent mare probably wont be far away
runners.name: Fromheretoeternity
runners.spotlight: Slightly disappointing when made favourite at Hexham last month but this largely consistent mare has edged her way back down to a workable mark and probably won't be far away.

runners.comment: Lightly raced 6yo who was close second in small field at Plumpton last month; considered
runners.name: La Marquise
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced since winning hurdle debut in October 2024 but has performed well on both outings this year, latterly when close second in small-field Plumpton handicap (2m2f, good to soft) last month; considered.

runners.comment: Made all at Warwick in September but absent since lesser effort in November
runners.name: Mary
runners.spotlight: Returned to form with front-running win at Warwick (2m3f, good) in September but absent since tame finishing effort in November (breathing issue reported) and remains on fairly tough mark.

runners.comment: Won three times on good ground last spring and is back on a good mark now
runners.name: D Day Arvalenreeva
runners.spotlight: Started off in handicap hurdles with three good-ground wins for Kevin Philippart de Foy last spring (2m-2m1f) and is back on a good mark now; just a respectable fourth when back over hurdles at Ludlow (2m, good) three weeks ago but still enters calculations.

runners.comment: Has held her own in some good-quality races this year but tends to finish weakly
runners.name: Anariza
runners.spotlight: 1-7 over hurdles; held her own in two good-quality novice races at start of this year and wasn't disgraced in valuable series final at Kelso last month; in calmer waters here but her tendency to finish weakly is a worry.

runners.comment: Displayed improvement to win Ludlow maiden last month; more needed again on handicap debut
runners.name: Borna Gem
runners.spotlight: Made shaky start to hurdling career during the winter but benefited from combination of drop in trip and switch to good ground when winning 2m Ludlow maiden by 4l last month; probably needs to improve again to overcome opening handicap mark but that's possible.

runners.breeder: A J Davenhill & Mrs A L Davenhill
runners.comment: Up in grade after her two Hereford wins but might still be improving
runners.name: Granny Hawkins
runners.spotlight: Came good at Hereford in the autumn and showed even better form when following up there (also 2m, good) last month, after a break; moves up in grade here but might still be improving; must be considered.

runners.comment: Four hurdles wins (one over C&D); made satisfactory return last month; high on the list
runners.name: Callin Baton Rouge
runners.spotlight: Four-time hurdles winner on good ground (once over C&D); ended 2025 with good second at Doncaster (2m, good) and made a satisfactory reappearance last month; can pose a significant threat from off the pace.

15:43.race_name: Racecourse Streams On Racing TV Extra Handicap Chase

runners.comment: Landed a four-timer in the summer of 2023 but hasn't won since.
runners.name: Chief Black Robe
runners.spotlight: Back with his former trainer on his last five starts; landed a four-timer for this yard in 2023; hasn't won since and has failed to complete on his last two starts; visor worn last time is left off; well handicapped if able to return to anywhere near his best form.

runners.comment: Won twice for Olly Murphy in the autumn but hasn't been in the same form since.
runners.name: Pescatorius
runners.spotlight: Won twice for Olly Murphy in the autumn and subsequently sold for 5,500gns; hasn't been in the same form in three runs for his current trainer; cheekpieces worn on his last three starts are dispensed with on this step up in trip; still has time on his side but all of a sudden has a bit to prove.

runners.comment: None too consistent but he has won five times over fences, latest at Plumpton in February.
runners.name: Felton Bellevue
runners.owner: Mrs H Munn R E Good B Case
runners.spotlight: None too consistent but he has won five times over fences, latest at Plumpton (3m1f, soft) in February off 3lb lower; beaten a neck back there off this mark last month and his best chance of further success is perhaps back at that venue.

runners.breeder: P De Maleissye Melun & T Amos
runners.comment: Got off the mark over fences at Huntingdon in February; in the money in two runs since.
runners.name: Carpe Diem
runners.spotlight: Got off the mark over fences at Huntingdon (2m4f, soft) in February with first-time visor applied (retained since); in the money in two runs since and now steps up beyond 3m for the first time; holds place claims at least.

runners.breeder: Haras De Saint Voir Sca & Mr Joel Denis
runners.comment: Sole success at Newton Abbot last June; has been tailed off on his last two starts.
runners.name: Illogical Logic
runners.spotlight: Landed his sole win off this mark at Newton Abbot (3m2f, good) last June but has been tailed off on his last two starts; would be considered if operating at his best but needs to sharpen up.

runners.comment: Won over fences at Hereford in October; second at Plumpton the following month.
runners.name: Unspeakable
runners.spotlight: Landed his second success over fences, at Hereford (3m1f, good) in October off 1lb lower mark; second at Plumpton the following month but was tailed off at Wincanton when last seen; has been freshened up since and holds claims if putting his best foot forward.

runners.comment: Sole success over fences came at Chepstow in March last year; soundly beaten since.
runners.name: Yes And Yes
runners.owner: David W Jagger & Mrs Belinda Clarke
runners.spotlight: Sole success over fences came at Chepstow in March last year off 2lb higher; soundly beaten since and steps up to beyond 3m for the first time; down to a career-low mark and needs this extra test of stamina to bring out improvement.

runners.comment: Five-time chase winner; placed over hurdles in the autumn; returns from a break
runners.name: Jet Of Dreams
runners.spotlight: Five-time chase winner who was placed on hurdle return at Kempton (2m, good) in October; absent since lesser effort in November but current mark is workable if he's fully tuned up.

runners.comment: Last month's handicap debut was underwhelming but that was his first run since September
runners.name: Three Pikes
runners.spotlight: Bumper winner who was placed in three good-ground maiden hurdles (2m1f-2m2f) last summer; safely held in Ludlow handicap last month, after a break, but might have needed that outing and remains lightly raced.

runners.comment: Not firing on all cylinders in the autumn when last seen; had wind op in February
runners.name: Renoir
runners.spotlight: Now 2lb lower than when winning at Hereford (2m, good) in spring 2025 but wasn't firing on all cylinders in the autumn when last seen and needs subsequent wind op to have made a difference; cheekpieces removed after one use.

runners.comment: Three-time C&D winner; ran well to a point last month, after a break; shortlisted
runners.name: Juan Bermudez
runners.spotlight: Gained all three hurdle wins over C&D on good ground, the latest by 7l from the front last June; ran well to a point here last month, after a layoff, and will be dangerous off this mark if that outing brought him on.

runners.comment: 0-5 over hurdles but not disgraced in valuable series final last month; cheekpieces on
runners.name: Klassy Pearl
runners.spotlight: 0-5 over hurdles but seemed to run well when second of four on handicap debut at Exeter (2m, heavy) in February and wasn't disgraced when midfield in valuable series final at Kelso (2m, good to soft) last month; sports first-time cheekpieces here; could have a say.

runners.breeder: Ashtown B/S O B Sarl E Puerari G Bozo
runners.comment: Won on the AW in February and is 5lb lower than when scoring over C&D in March 2025
runners.name: Chicago Storm
runners.spotlight: Out of form in December when last seen over hurdles but looked back in good nick when winning on AW in February and is 5lb lower than when scoring over C&D (good to soft) in March 2025; interesting.

runners.comment: 0-7 over hurdles but dropped 5lb since respectable fourth in February; worth second look
runners.name: Ufouria
runners.spotlight: 0-7 over hurdles but kept on for respectable fourth at Bangor (2m, soft) in February, her fourth start for Alastair Ralph, and has dropped another 5lb since; may benefit from this move back up in trip; worth a second look.

runners.comment: Out of sorts this spring; needs huge boost from first-time cheekpieces
runners.name: Chief Sunday
runners.spotlight: Chasing didn't go to plan in the autumn (three attempts) and he's looked out of sorts over hurdles lately; will appreciate this ease in grade but still needs huge boost from the first-time cheekpieces.

runners.comment: Has shown signs of promise but he was pulled up on handicap debut at Exeter on Friday
runners.name: Monsun Climate
runners.spotlight: Signs of promise in novice/maiden hurdles but pulled up on handicap debut at Exeter (2m, good) on Friday, following wind surgery.

runners.comment: 0-8 over hurdles but second stable run was much better than the first; not ruled out
runners.name: Mistral Milly
runners.owner: John Murray & Exor Of Late Niall Farrell
runners.spotlight: 0-8 over hurdles but bettered low-key stable debut when keeping-on fourth at Warwick (2m, good; first-time tongue-tie) last month and ought to be suited by this move back up in trip; not ruled out.

runners.comment: Absent since two disappointing runs in November; market helpful on stable debut
runners.name: Estacas
runners.spotlight: Well handicapped on old form for David Bridgwater but absent since two disappointing runs in November 2023; considered only if lively in the betting before this stable debut; had wind op in 2024.

runners.comment: C&D winner last spring but needs to respond well to change of headgear today
runners.name: Time Interval
runners.spotlight: Won over C&D and at Warwick (2m) on good ground in May last year but his two runs in cheekpieces this spring were underwhelming and he needs to respond well to a first-time visor.

runners.comment: Did not get seriously competitive in four 2m novice hurdles; handicap debut today
runners.name: Can U Feel It
runners.spotlight: Did not get seriously competitive in four 2m novice hurdles, although attracted the stewards' attention when making steady late headway on one occasion; up in trip for handicap debut; worth a glance in the betting.

runners.breeder: D & S L Tanker Transport Ltd
runners.comment: Well beaten on both starts since a break (Flat/hurdle); sports refitted cheekpieces
runners.name: Legendary Day
runners.spotlight: Useful on the Flat in his prime but suffered heavy defeat in that sphere last month, after a layoff, and also struggled in a handicap hurdle three weeks ago; sports refitted cheekpieces; others have much less to prove.

runners.comment: Safely held in all four handicaps, the latest here (2m6f) last month
runners.name: Farhh Echo
runners.spotlight: Showed significant improvement when fourth in Worcester maiden (2m, good) last summer but safely held in all four subsequent handicaps, the latest here (2m6f) last month; needs to turn a corner.

16:53.race_name: Geely Leamington Spa Novices' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners.breeder: C A F R E Enniskellen Campus
runners.comment: Won from the front over 2m4f at Ludlow last month and will also be suited by this trip
runners.name: Bond Broker
runners.spotlight: Doesn't help himself by tending to race too freely but got off the mark over fences at fifth attempt, with front-running success at Ludlow (2m4f, good) last month; 5lb rise is offset by Jay Tidball's claim here, and this drop back in trip won't be a problem; respected.

runners.comment: Off since disappointing run on New Year's Day but could still have potential over fences
runners.name: Mister Cessna
runners.spotlight: Won readily by 5l on British chasing debut at Uttoxeter in October (2m, good); absent since disappointing run over 2m4f on New Year's Day but could still have potential and will be dangerous if back on song after 108-day break.

runners.comment: 2-6 over fences this season; comes here after good effort at Ascot last month; good chance
runners.name: Pure Carbon
runners.spotlight: 2-6 over fences this season, the wins gained at Huntingdon (2m, good) and Musselburgh (2m, good to soft); gave another good account when close third of five at Ascot (2m1f, good) last month and should be fine on this left-handed track; good chance.

runners.comment: Kept on well to score at Huntingdon this month but 6lb rise demands more from him here
runners.name: Park Annonciade
runners.spotlight: Started off for Sarah Humphrey with two disappointing hurdle runs in the autumn but has turned things around over fences since, and kept on well to win by 7l at Huntingdon (2m, good) a fortnight ago; recent 6lb rise demands more from him here, though.

runners.comment: Drew clear to win Ludlow hunter chase last month and followed up in a recent point
runners.name: Killer Clown
runners.spotlight: Useful in his prime; drew clear to win Ludlow hunter chase (2m4f, good) by 13l last month and followed up in open point at Hornby Castle (2m6f, good to firm) eight days ago; obvious contender.

runners.comment: Placed at Cheltenham last year and comes here after two small-field point wins this spring
runners.name: Important Notice
runners.spotlight: Creditable third at Cheltenham (3m2f, good) on rules debut just under a year ago and comes here after two small-field open point wins at Trebudannon (both 3m, good to soft) this spring; has a part to play.

runners.breeder: S A R L Haras Du Berlais
runners.comment: Dug deep to beat useful rival in small-field point in January; enters calculations
runners.name: Kansas Du Berlais
runners.spotlight: Made the frame (albeit safely held) in two good-quality hunter chases (2m/2m1f) last May and dug deep to beat useful rival in small-field open point at Charing (3m, good to soft; subsequently disqualified) in January; turned over at short odds in latest point but still enters calculations.

runners.comment: Second to top hunter chaser Barton Snow over C&D last May and 3-3 in points this year
runners.name: Largy Pearl
runners.spotlight: Honourable second to top hunter chaser Barton Snow over C&D (good) on rules debut last May and 3-3 in points this year; the one to beat.

runners.comment: About 31l behind Killer Clown at Ludlow last month; the one with most to prove
runners.name: Amidnightstar
runners.spotlight: Absent for three years after winning maiden hurdle in February 2023, and finished about 31l behind Killer Clown on last month's rules return at Ludlow (2m4f, good); close second in two-runner point since; tongue-tie added today.
